description: A hired expert's kickoff: it opens its two-question onboarding card, holds the rest of the turn open until the journey has answered the first question, then answers the card once it is sent. The marker rides in the expert's writing sample, since the platform writes the kickoff message itself. experts-journey.spec.ts follows it.
title: Getting started

input.greeting: Hi, I'm here to clear the routine off your plate.

steps.question: Which outcome should I start with?

turns.text: Tap an answer whenever you are ready and I will take it from there.
Thanks. I will start with your meeting briefs and read Google Calendar.
